Retrieve the spin filter columns (provided in the kit) from fridge to warm them up to Room temperature for use at step 25 "provided in the kit" refers to: DNeasy PowerSoil Kit (100) Cat No./ID: 12888-100 A spin filter column is a spin filter unit sitting in a collection column. The spin filter unit contains the membrane.

steps.title: Prepare cold rack
steps.instruction: Place a 1.5 mL/2 mL tube rack in a 4 °C refrigerator; this rack will be used for all incubation steps later.

steps.title: Label all tubes
steps.instruction: For each sample label one 2 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock DNA LoBind tube and one 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock DNA LoBind tube; also label one PowerBead tube, one spin‑filter column, and three 2 mL collection tubes (provided in the kit). Label both the top and the sides of the PowerSoil bead tube because the top label may be rubbed off during bead‑beating.

steps.title: Prepare extraction blanks
steps.instruction: Make two extraction‑blank PowerSoil bead tubes per batch: one blank receives no material, the second receives a small piece of sterile gauze.

steps.title: Sterilize scissors and forceps
steps.instruction: Wipe scissors with 75 % ethanol, then with HPLC‑grade water, and dry. Wipe forceps the same way. Change gloves and re‑sterilize scissors and forceps between each sample.

steps.title: Clip and place gauze sample
steps.instruction: Using the sterilized scissors, clip a small piece of gauze containing plaque (no more than half of the plaque) and place it into a PowerSoil bead tube with the sterilized forceps.

steps.title: Submerge gauze in bead tube
steps.instruction: Invert the PowerSoil bead tube several times to mix and fully submerge the gauze with plaque.

steps.title: Add C1 solution
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of solution C1 to the bead tube and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL proteinase K (10 mg/mL) to the tube and rotate the tube several times to mix.

steps.title: Bead‑beat sample
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in an OmniBeadRuptor, secure the lid (do not overtighten), and run at 2.9 m/s for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge bead tube
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 9 400 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the supernatant to a 2 mL collection tube (provided in the kit) while leaving the gauze in the bead tube; avoid transferring beads or dust.

steps.title: Store bead tube backup
steps.instruction: Save the PowerSoil bead tubes at –20 °C as a backup until extraction success is confirmed; discard after confirmation.

steps.title: Add C3 solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of solution C3 to the collected supernatant and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 4 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00) on the pre‑cooled rack.

steps.title: Centrifuge after C3
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 9 400 × g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 750 µL of the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube (provided in the kit).

steps.title: Store remaining supernatant
steps.instruction: Store any remaining supernatant at –20 °C as a backup until extraction success is confirmed; discard after confirmation.

steps.title: Add C4 solution
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 mL of solution C4 to the supernatant, vortex for 5 seconds, ensuring the liquid does not exceed the rim of the tube.

steps.title: Load mixture onto spin filter
steps.instruction: Load approximately 675 µL of the C4‑containing mixture into the spin‑filter unit and centrifuge for 1 minute at 9 400 × g (room temperature).

steps.title: Pass mixture through filter repeatedly
steps.instruction: Repeat loading ~675 µL and centrifugation until the entire mixture has passed through the spin‑filter unit (typically 2–3 passes).

steps.title: Add C5 wash solution
steps.instruction: Load 500 µL of solution C5 onto the spin‑filter unit and centrifuge for 1 minute at 9 400 × g (room temperature).

steps.title: Dry spin filter
steps.instruction: Perform a dry spin of the spin‑filter unit for 1 minute at 9 400 × g (room temperature).

steps.title: Place filter into collection tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin‑filter unit into a clean 2 mL collection tube (or a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, if preferred).

steps.title: Pre‑warm C6 solution
steps.instruction: Place solution C6 in an incubator and pre‑heat to 37 °C.

steps.title: Elute DNA with C6
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of the pre‑warmed C6 solution onto the centre of the membrane in the spin‑filter unit and incubate for 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin‑filter unit for 30 seconds at 9 400 × g (room temperature) to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Remove the spin‑filter unit and quantify 3 µL of the eluate using the Qubit dsDNA BR Kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Store eluate
steps.instruction: Store the remaining eluate at –20 °C.
